title: Maintaining Proper Trap Arm Length Before the Vent
description: A P-trap relies on a liquid seal to prevent sewer gases from entering a building. A common installation mistake is placing the vent connection too close to the P-trap weir. The horizontal pipe section between the trap weir and the vent fitting—known as the trap arm—must be at least two pipe diameters long before turning into the vent fitting. If the trap arm is too short, turbulence at the trap discharge can cause self-siphoning, pulling the protective water seal out of the trap. Always check local plumbing code standards to ensure correct minimum distances.
